notes: Raw model output -> the action or the parse error the model would see, for src/background/agent/parse.ts (parseModelReply), and later for the Python runner.
input is the reply as one string, or an array of lines that are joined with a newline.
scope says which verbs the reply may use: "all" is every verb of shared/actions.json (what the old engine passes), or {mode, tier} is verbsFor(mode, tier) of that file. The default is "all".
refs says which element ids are on the page: a number N means 1..N, an array is the exact list, null means the list is not known. The default is 10.

expect.action is the exact action object (key order does not matter). expect.error is the exact error text, expect.kind is the rule that rejected the reply, and expect.thought is the text of the think tag.
neverFinish means that whatever the result is, it must not be a finish action. It is set on the tool-call cases, because a reply in tool-call markup must never end the run by accident.
